name.description: Name of the workflow created by this spec from the {@link #createWorkflow} API.

modelFilter.description:
Specify which {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s to validate by passing in a {@link Filter}.
Only the models satisfying the filter condition will be validated.

If {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelValidationJobOptions#models} is also specified, that will take precedence

modelTrainingJobRun.description:
Instead of specifying the list of models to validate directly, specify an
{@link MlModel.Train.JobRun} that has successfully completed. The trained models
from this {@link MlModel.Train.JobRun} will then be validated.

If {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelValidationJobOptions#models}
and/or {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelValidationJobOptions#modelFilter} are also specified, those will take precedence.

assets.description:
All the {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s deployed against these assets will be validated.
To filter any particular asset to model relations, use {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelValidationJobOptions#filterRelationsLambda}

assetFilter.description:
Specify {@link ReliabilityAsset}s for which you want validate {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s.
By default, all the {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s related to {@link ReliabilityAsset} via {@link ReliabilityAssetToRiskModelRelation}s will be validated.

To filter any particular {@link ReliabilityAssetToRiskModelRelation}, {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelValidationJobOptions#filterRelationsLambda}
If {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelValidationJobOptions#assets} is also specified, that will take precedence.

filterRelationsLambda.description:
An optional lambda, which when provided will be used to filter {@link ReliabilityAssetToRiskModelRelation}s.
The following fields of a {@link ReliabilityAssetToRiskModelRelation} are available for each relation and can be used in the function code:
- `to`, `from`, `start`, `end`, `status` and `route`
For example,
```py
myRelationFilter = "def filter_relations(asset_to_model_relations): return asset_to_model_relations[0]"
opts = options.make({"filterRelationsLambda": myRelationFilter})

Only the first asset to model relation resolved from the options will be scheduled through this job.
```

validationPeriod.description: Specify the {@link TimeRange} for which the models should be validated.

options.description:
Use this field to specify the {@link BatchJobOptions} that should be used for running the underlying
{@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelValidationJob}

title: Provides an interface to orchestrate a {@link Workflow} to validate {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.Spec.ModelValidation
